row.title: SEED-AUTONOMY-1: a seed that answers /health is not autonomous
row.body: Probed 2026-11-23: GET https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/health returned 200 with tick 207 complete while the same report read stalled at ignition stage ticking with 13 loops failing. Root cause: deploy/deploy-seed.mjs binds only DB and PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY, so a generated seed has no source-control credential and no repository of its own, and the launch gate judged /health alone. This change: /health carries the ignition stage, seedadmit --autonomy with detector seed-autonomous fails a seed below looping 48 h after its first live row, the year gate refuses undrilled faults, and health fetches name their client (the default Python user agent got 403 at the edge, so detector seed-live was failing on a seed that answered). Tests pass: tests.foundation.test_seedadmit, seed/tests/test_seed.py, seed/worker/test/health-ignition.test.js. The credential root cause is OL-20261123-1.
